llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed WechatSync publishing helper whose sensitive access is tied to its stated purpose, with a supply-chain caution around installing an unpinned npm CLI.

dimensions.detail: Use of a local token, localhost CLI-to-extension communication, browser login sessions, and uploads to target platform CDNs is disclosed and proportionate for cross-posting content.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: It depends on an external Chrome extension and the @wechatsync/cli npm package installed globally, but the package version is not pinned.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Commands are explicit, user-directed, and scoped to chosen files and platforms; the skill instructs the agent to confirm prerequisites and not install packages without explicit consent.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The global npm CLI and browser extension are persistent components, but the artifact does not request privilege escalation, background services, memory writes, tool hijacking, or hidden persistence.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill publishes or drafts user-provided Markdown/HTML articles to many content platforms and checks login status, which matches its stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only from the intended npm registry and Chrome Web Store/source, avoid elevated installs, consider pinning or reviewing the @wechatsync/cli version, and remember the extension can act through browser sessions for platforms where you are logged in.
llm.findings: [T08] expected: The external npm CLI dependency is expected for this skill, but the unpinned global install is a real supply-chain hygiene concern rather than evidence of malicious behavior in the artifact.
